answer: The orchard graph is validated at intake and the island frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and quartz anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Duplicating the work 59 times multiplies the fee by 186 and leaves every copy exposed to a single slash, so the downside scales faster than the headcount. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
